vulnerable_code:
from rest_framework import viewsets, permissions
from model_utils.models import StatusModel
from .models import SupportEscalationTicket
from .serializers import SupportEscalationTicketSerializer

class SupportEscalationTicketViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    serializer_class = SupportEscalationTicketSerializer
    queryset = SupportEscalationTicket.objects.all()

    def perform_update(self, serializer):
        # Directly saves serializer on global queryset without checking tenant boundary
        serializer.save()
diagnosis: SupportEscalationTicketViewSet inherits from ModelViewSet with queryset = SupportEscalationTicket.objects.all(). While DRF checks authentication, it performs no tenant scoping in get_queryset(). A customer from Tenant A can issue a PATCH request to /api/support-tickets/<id>/ with {"status": "resolved"} or {"status": "closed"} to forcefully close and modify support escalation tickets belonging to Tenant B.
